thread:
Marta: Heads up — noticed a ~$12k jump in egress yesterday tied to model-artifact snapshots. Billing export shows large inter-region transfers from eu-west1 -> us-central1 and asia-southeast1 around 02:10 UTC.
Ben: yikes. Any idea what triggered the transfers? new pipeline?
Marta: Looks like the snapshot push job (artifact-pusher) retried on a stale config after the model onboarding. Replication config had 'replicate: all-regions' enabled by default.
Priya: Can you paste the billing export query and a sample log line? I can pull cost attribution.
Marta: SQL I ran in BigQuery: ```SELECT project, region, SUM(egress_bytes)/1024/1024/1024 AS egress_gb, DATE(timestamp) as day FROM `billing.gcp_raw_exports.*` WHERE service.description="Cloud Storage" AND sku.description LIKE "%Inter-Region Egress%" AND DATE(timestamp) BETWEEN "2026-03-01" AND "2026-03-05" GROUP BY project, region, day ORDER BY egress_gb DESC LIMIT 50;```
Marta: sample storage log: `PUT /models/rdw-v2/snapshots/20260304.tgz 200 0.0s src=35.195.1.22 dst=35.190.10.5 bytes=10737418240 region=eu-west1 target=us-central1`
Alex: That bytes number matches the bill. artifact-pusher does a fanout to all replica regions when `target_regions` is null. Default used to be empty->all. We changed that flag last month but onboarding jobs use an older image.
Priya: Ok — short term: can we halt the pusher and disable cross-region replication for the affected bucket? I'll coordinate with finance for a billing dispute/adjustment ticket if it's clearly accidental.
Ben: How many snapshots were pushed? Is this one-off or repeated?
Marta: There were 3 large pushes in a 40m window for the same model family (rdw-v2). Each ~10GB compressed shard -> multiple 10s of TB egress total.
Alex: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) revoke artifact-pusher service account permission to write to remote-region buckets, 2) flip onboarding job to use new image with explicit target_regions, 3) add lifecycle rule to delete cross-region temp copies after 24h.
Priya: I'll open a billing investigation with cloud support — need the exact timestamps and the object names. Marta can you dump the storage object list (path + time + bytes)?
Marta: on it. Running: ```gsutil ls -l gs://redwood-models-eu-west1/models/rdw-v2/snapshots/20260304* | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}' > /tmp/rdw-snapshots.txt``` will attach in the ticket.
infra-bot: alert: high-egress-detected project=infra-prod severity=warning egress_gb=20480 window=02:00-03:00 UTC
Ben: If finance questions why we didn't use dedicated region storage, note that Dedicated pools pin model artifacts to region but onboarding pipeline writes to central storage by default. That's a process gap.
Priya: Longer-term: we should enforce per-customer default region and prevent wildcard replication in onboarding images. Also propose a reserved-capacity credit clause for accidental replication during onboarding tests.
Alex: Agree. I'll make a PR to change the artifact-pusher default and add a unit test verifying target_regions is required.
Marta: For now, I've disabled the pusher flag and added a temporary firewall rule to block remote bucket writes for the pusher SA. Will upload the /tmp/rdw-snapshots.txt to the ticket in 5m.
Ben: Thanks — once we have the object list I can estimate the refundable portion and prepare notes for finance.
Priya: Tagging @Finance in the ticket and CC'ing legal for SLA exceptions.
Marta: TL;DR: accidental global replication from old onboarding image caused cross-region egress spike, mitigations applied, billing ticket opened, follow-up actions: default region enforcement + pipeline upgrade + lifecycle rule. :thumbsup:
Alex: Also add a monitoring rule: anomaly if inter-region egress > 2TB in 1h from a single service account.
Priya: Logged follow-up tasks in board under INFRA-923.
Marta: closing the thread here after ticket creation. Thanks all.
